title: Republika
creator: HRT
description: A documentary series from Croatian public television on the Republic of Ragusa, with reenactments of its government, trade, and diplomacy. It shows how a small city stayed independent between Venice and the Ottoman Empire until Napoleon ended it in 1808.

title: Libertas
creator: Veljko Bulajić
description: A drama about Marin Držić, Dubrovnik’s great Renaissance playwright, whose comedies mocked the city’s nobility. The film imagines his clashes with the republic’s rulers. His house on Široka Street is now a small museum about his life.

title: Game of Thrones
creator: David Benioff & D.B. Weiss
description: HBO’s fantasy series used Dubrovnik as King’s Landing, the capital of its kingdoms, from the second season to the last. The walls, Fort Lovrijenac, and many old town streets appear, and the show changed the city’s tourism for good.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
creator: Rian Johnson
description: The scenes in Canto Bight, a casino city for the rich, include street shots filmed on the Stradun, Dubrovnik’s main street, in 2016. The old town was closed to the public for several days during the shoot.

title: Robin Hood
creator: Otto Bathurst
description: A loose retelling of the Robin Hood legend, starring Taron Egerton, that used Dubrovnik’s old town to stand in for medieval Nottingham. The production filmed in the streets and squares in early 2017.
